from pathlib import Path
import torch,json
reports=[]
for path in sorted(Path('/inputs').glob('*-rank-0-*.pt')):
 d=torch.load(path,weights_only=True,map_location='cpu');page=d['page_size'];width=d['width'];rows=len(d['q'])
 assert width%page==0 and int(d['active'][0])<=width and int(d['lengths'].max())<=width
 copied=min(d['table'].shape[1],width//page)
 assert copied*page>=int(d['lengths'].max())
 table=torch.zeros(rows,width//page,dtype=torch.int32)
 table[:,:copied].copy_(d['table'][:,:copied])
 assert torch.equal(table[:,:copied],d['table'][:,:copied]) and not bool(table[:,copied:].any())
 assert int(table.min())>=0 and int(table.max())<len(d['pool'])
 reports.append({'file':path.name,'page':page,'planned_width':width,'visible_min':int(d['lengths'].min()),'visible_max':int(d['lengths'].max()),'captured_table_columns':d['table'].shape[1],'proxy_table_columns':table.shape[1],'visible_mappings_preserved':True,'unused_suffix_initialized':True})
assert len(reports)==12
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'files':reports}))
